Jianying Video Editor 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Instantly edit and export social videos by describing your desired result (e.g., auto-cut, add captions, sync music).
- Effortless cloud processing: uploads and edits require no local installation.
- Automatic 1080p export as MP4; other formats supported.
- Integrated credit management and session handling (with 100 free credits for new users).
- File upload, export, and workflow management through clear chat instructions.
- Designed for quick turnaround (1–2 minutes for short videos) and user-friendly feedback at every step.
